description:
Look up one uploaded file for a question about it.

    Confirms the file belongs to the user and returns its details (name,
    type, row or chunk count) together with the question. Use this when the user
    asks about one specific file; get the file_id from list_files first.

    Limits: requires sign-in. It doesn't compute answers from the file's
    contents; those are in LuBot's My Files chat. Questions are capped at
    2000 characters.
name: analyze_file
title: Analyze a File
